description: GO annotation evidence matrix for BBS10, BBS6, BBS12 against the CCT4 control
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
df=pd.read_csv("bbs10/quickgo_annotations.csv")
NAME={"Q8TAM1":"BBS10","Q9NPJ1":"BBS6/MKKS","Q6ZW61":"BBS12","P50991":"CCT4"}
df["gene"]=df.acc.map(NAME)
TERMS={"GO:0005524":"ATP binding","GO:0016887":"ATP hydrolysis activity",
       "GO:0140662":"ATP-dependent protein folding chaperone","GO:0044183":"protein folding chaperone",
       "GO:0006457":"protein folding","GO:0005515":"protein binding","GO:0061629":"RNA pol II TF binding"}
RANK={"EXP":4,"IDA":4,"IMP":4,"IPI":3,"TAS":2,"IBA":2,"ISS":2,"HDA":3,"IEA":1}
genes=["CCT4","BBS6/MKKS","BBS10","BBS12"]; terms=list(TERMS)
M=np.zeros((len(genes),len(terms))); lab=np.full((len(genes),len(terms)),"",dtype=object)
for i,g in enumerate(genes):
    for j,t in enumerate(terms):
        s=df[(df.gene==g)&(df.go==t)]
        if len(s)==0: continue
        best=max(s.ev,key=lambda e:RANK.get(e,0))
        M[i,j]=RANK.get(best,0); lab[i,j]=best
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,3.4))
im=ax.imshow(M,cmap="YlGnBu",vmin=0,vmax=4,aspect="auto")
ax.set_xticks(range(len(terms))); ax.set_xticklabels([f"{t}\n{TERMS[t]}" for t in terms],fontsize=7.5)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(genes))); ax.set_yticklabels(genes,fontsize=10)
for i in range(len(genes)):
    for j in range(len(terms)):
        ax.text(j,i,lab[i,j] or "absent",ha="center",va="center",fontsize=8,
                color="white" if M[i,j]>2.5 else "0.2")
ax.set_title("Current GO annotation and best evidence code (QuickGO, retrieved 2026-11-24)\n"
             "ATP binding on BBS6, BBS10 and BBS12 rests on InterPro IEA (GO_REF:0000002) alone",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print(df.groupby(["gene","ev"]).size().unstack(fill_value=0).to_string())
